scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked --no-deps --all-features
